name: kodhama
description: The kodhama marketplace — one install door for the stewards: trellis (governance), grove (agent swarm), spore (session drivers).

plugins.name: trellis
plugins.description: Install and consult Trellis in a Claude Code project: the invariants, expressed at your strength.

plugins.name: grove
plugins.description: Compose Grove's thirteen-role operating model through generated host adapters and repo-owned configuration via /grove:setup.

plugins.name: spore
plugins.description: Session-driver skills for Claude Code — spawn, hot-fork, and tend Remote-Control sessions & plugins from the side (macOS). Loads spore:<skill> skills; install via /plugin install spore@kodhama.
